title: My Angel
subtitle: The Greatest Gift God Quietly Planned
quote: Some people enter your life by chance... but stay forever in your heart.
endQuote: And if one day someone asks me... 'What was the most beautiful coincidence of your life?' I will smile and answer... 'Her name is Grace Esther.'

content.text: I often ask myself one question.
I don't think I need one.
Because some relationships are too beautiful to be explained with a single word.
When I think about the person I was before December 11, 2024...
Then I look at myself today.
Grace didn't just become part of my life. She changed me. She made me a better human being.
She reminded me to stay strong.
People often ask why I call her "My Angel."
Because angels don't always have wings.
They simply walk into your life on an ordinary evening and change everything forever.
I thought I was taking a shortcut across campus.
It wasn't a shortcut. It was destiny leading me toward the most beautiful gift God had planned for me.
I don't know where this journey will take us.
I don't know what tomorrow holds.
But one thing will always remain true.
Meeting Grace was one of the greatest blessings of my life.
Whether the world calls it friendship...
Or whether it remains a story without a name...
It will always be precious to me.
Because every beautiful memory I created with her became a chapter that I will carry in my heart forever.
And if one day someone asks me...
"What was the most beautiful coincidence of your life?"
She wasn't just someone I met.
She became the reason I believed that sometimes... God writes the most beautiful stories when we least expect them.
